name: Cloudtail Cat Café
description: A cozy café in the sky where cats with cloud-like tails lounge on floating cushions beside round windows.
prompt: A single cozy scene of a dreamy sky café with round windows, floating cushions, and steaming cups. Several cats with fluffy cloud-like tails lounge on shelves and windowsills, watching distant sunrise clouds. Warm wood, soft pastel light, gentle fantasy, inviting atmosphere, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: This café has warm drinks, soft cushions, and cats with cloud tails. Which table would you choose?
